content:
I'm getting a strange lake build failure in a project, that I wonder if it's related to having too many files. I provide instructions to reproduce it, but of course I'm not expecting anyone to do it (it takes many hours for the issue to appear). The project contains around 25,000 files. It used to build successfully in 4.28.

My question is whether this error is familiar to someone, or if someone has any hints about how to debug it. Thank you in advance.

How to reproduce

git clone https://github.com/provables/sequencelib.git
cd sequencelib
git switch cache-tool
lake exe cache get
lake build Sequencelib

The error I get consistently (although not deterministically) is the following. Sometimes the actual file that shows up in the error is different.

error: Sequencelib/Synthetic.lean:1:0: failed to read file '/home/wmoreira24/sequencelib/.lake/build/lib/lean/Sequencelib/Synthetic/A277/A277990.olean'
error: Lean exited with code 1
Some required targets logged failures:
- Sequencelib.Synthetic
error: build failed

The .olean is actually in .lake/build, it seems successfully compiled, by looking at the logs. And strangely, running lake build Sequencelib.Synthetic.A277 or lake build Sequencelib.Synthetic.A277.A277990 succeeds. Running lake build SequencelibLite, which is a file importing a small sample of the files, also succeeds.

(Disclaimer: this project does not use AI. The Synthetic files are generated programatically from a data set.)
